scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:web: env -u LD_PRELOAD -u HTTP_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u http_proxy -u https_proxy npm run dev --prefix frontend
scripts.dev:api: env -u LD_PRELOAD -u HTTP_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u http_proxy -u https_proxy .venv/bin/uvicorn backend.app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
